senses.definition: The time of day when the Sun seems to reach its highest point in the sky; solar noon.
examples: On Saturdays, I love to have a lie-in until noon.
The race is due to start at noon sharp.

quotes.text: The terms of the President and Vice President shall end at noon on the 20th day of January, and the terms of Senators and Representatives at noon on the 3d day of January, of the years in which such terms would have ended if this article had not been ratified; and the terms of their successors shall then begin.

subsenses.definition: The mean time of solar noon, marked as twelve o'clock on most clocks.

senses.definition: (now rare) The corresponding time in the middle of the night; midnight.

quotes.text: So the sad mother at the noon of night / From bloody Memphis stole her silent flight […].
